start.title: Foster a rescue dog or cat
start.intro: Foster carers give rescued dogs and cats a home while they wait for a family of their own. Tell us about yourself and your home; it takes about ten minutes.
start.saved_hint: Every answer is saved as you go. Come back to an application at any time by its reference.

help.title: What fostering involves
help.what: A foster carer looks after a rescued dog or cat at home for a few weeks or months, until it is adopted.
help.costs: The rescue pays for food, bedding and vet care. You give the animal time, patience and a safe place.
help.form: The application has five sections. Fill them in any order; each answer is saved as you go, and you can come back later by the application's reference.
help.after: Once you submit, the foster team reads your application and phones you to arrange a home visit.
